suggestions.assertion: RESULT.md presents an approval-ready decision covering objective, triggers, stages and exact repository-backed commands, agents, immutable artifact identity, environments, production approval, rollback, credential IDs, plugin dependencies, validation, and risks.
suggestions.reason: This single binary assertion bundles many independently important properties, so a future result missing one property would fail without showing which pipeline-decision dimension regressed. Split it into a small number of discriminating assertions, especially (1) trigger/stage/command fidelity, (2) artifact promotion/approval/rollback, and (3) infrastructure dependencies/validation/risks.

No assertion directly requires the approval process to surface repository blockers and unresolved user-owned decisions before implementation. Add an assertion that the report identifies the inconsistent lockfile, absent publication/digest and environment-verification commands, print-only ops scripts, and unresolved approval/rollback ownership without inventing answers; this is central to the skill's decision gate and would distinguish a merely well-formatted proposal from a safe one.

eval_feedback.overall: The assertions cover the core approval gate and immutable-promotion behavior and all pass on substantive evidence. The main weakness is that the broad report-quality assertion obscures which decision dimensions are actually tested, while blocker discovery and unresolved-decision handling are not independently enforced.
